entities.summary: Gabriele Giordano Caccia is an Italian Catholic prelate who works in the diplomatic service of the Holy See. He was named apostolic nuncio to the United States in March 2026. He previously served in the Secretariat of State, then as apostolic nuncio to Lebanon and the Philippines, and then as the permanent observer of the Holy See to the United Nations from 2020 to 2026.
